description: Localization file for Select2 version 4.0.6-rc.1, providing Bosnian (bs) language strings used for internationalization in the Select2 plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the error message for failed data loading.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the user should delete characters to fit within maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to type more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown when loading more results.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message shown when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message shown during a search operation.
